## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Image generation (CARRY-FORWARD from 2026-08-15, tools, ~8h, HIGH)

- **What**: Cline #13025 "feat(llms): add model-driven image generation" (merged 2026-08-15, CARRY-FORWARD). Comprehensive image generation support: added `capabilities: ["image-generation"]` to model catalog, SDK model capability validation, image generation model routing, streaming image responses, runtime tool ownership preservation, desktop image relay, model catalog regeneration, capability passthrough at catalog boundary (toSdkModelInfo / adaptSdkModelInfo preserve SDK capability list verbatim, union user overrides, emit explicit "tools" signal), shared `modelHasCapability(model, capability, {assumeWhenUnspecified})` helper. Fix: VS Code round-trips model metadata through legacy ModelInfo shape; toSdkModelInfo was reconstructing capability arrays from legacy booleans alone (no "tools" projection), every model came back as "cannot call tools", sessions registered zero tools, file-edit e2e failed.
- **Why**: Alexi has image generation INFRASTRUCTURE (src/providers/transform.ts exports extractImageChunk + NormalizedImageChunk for URL/base64 image payloads, sapOrchestration.ts declares `ModelCapability = 'image-generation' | 'tools' | 'embeddings'`, comments reference issue #1389 "SAP AI Core orchestration is planned to expose chat models with image generation via streaming responses") but NO user-facing capability (no image-gen tool, no model capability validation gating, no streaming image handler in TUI, no command interface). Cline's #13025 adds comprehensive end-to-end: model catalog declares image-gen capability, SDK validates and routes, streaming responses work, desktop relays images. Users increasingly expect multi-modal output (code + diagrams, UI mockups, data visualizations). Alexi's SAP AI Core providers support image-gen models (Anthropic Claude can generate, Gemini has Imagen, Stable Diffusion deployments available). HIGH priority: adds new user-facing capability (image generation on demand), infrastructure exists (transform.ts + ModelCapability enum) but needs tool/command wrapper + capability validation + TUI streaming image renderer + tests, ~8h. Proven pattern from Cline's comprehensive implementation. CARRY-FORWARD from 2026-08-15, remains top actionable.
- **Source**: Cline PR #13025 "feat(llms): add model-driven image generation" (merged 2026-08-15). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13025. Adds image generation support with model capabilities, validation, streaming, SDK catalog integration, desktop relay, capability passthrough fix.
- **Category**: tools (image generation). **Size**: ~8h. **Priority**: HIGH (new user-facing capability, infrastructure exists, proven pattern, SAP AI Core supports image-gen models). **Status**: CARRY-FORWARD from 2026-08-15.
